# keel

> Sara is your 24/7 deal assistant for B2B sales reps. Text or call her when deal context shows up in life — conference lunch, hallway, drive home. Private to you. No customer recording. No manager feed.

## What this is

keel gives quota-carrying B2B Account Executives a phone number for Sara. Text or call after the moments no meeting bot can join. She asks what you skipped, saves what you tell her to keep, and stays yours.

Founded 2026. Early access is limited and granted in waves as applications are reviewed.

## Key facts

- Product: Sara — 24/7 deal assistant for B2B AEs
- Pricing: Founders Club — free while we build with you; seats limited; no credit card. General pricing has not yet been announced.
- Stage: Early access / Founders Club applications open
- Target user: Mid-market B2B AEs with 8–20 live deals whose pipeline moves off-CRM
- Differentiator: Rep-first. Unrecordable moments. Text or call — not a CRM connector or meeting bot.

## How Sara works

1. Reach her — text or call the moment it happens
2. She works it — asks what you skipped; saves what you tell her to keep
3. Stays yours — no manager feed; no customer recording

## Use cases

- Conference lunch: text name, company, what they said
- Sideline / hallway / airport: catch a spark before it fades
- Drive home after a client meeting: call Sara and dump the context hands-free
- Think through champion vs economic buyer gaps without a manager dashboard

## Differentiators vs competitors

- vs Gong / Chorus: Gong owns the recorded call for managers. Sara owns what happens after you hang up — for you.
- vs Conversation Intelligence: No bot in the meeting. You reach out.
- vs CRM hygiene tools: Works from what you tell her, not what Salesforce forgot.

## Common questions

- Is Sara always on? — Once you're in, yes. Access is application-reviewed.
- Will my manager see what I tell Sara? — No. Sara reports to you. Nothing goes up the org chart unless you choose to share it.
- Does she record my customer calls? — Never.
- Do I need a clean CRM? — No.
- Do I need IT/manager approval? — No. Individual early access.
